_reasons.num_layers: 16, as the routing adapter: same base, same capacity; a yes/no head needs no more
_reasons.batch_size: 4: prompts are ~700 tokens; fits beside a resident scorer on the 32 GB Studio
_reasons.iters: 1200: about 3 epochs of a few thousand balanced examples; early stopping comes from valid loss in the log
_reasons.learning_rate: 1e-5, the routing adapter's rate: higher rates overfit the few-session label set
_reasons.max_seq_length: 1536: the compact state is sized to stay far under it (see compaction_dataset.py)
_reasons.mask_prompt: train only on the yes/no answer, as the routing SFT does
_reasons.steps_per_eval: 100: valid loss every 100 steps (12 points over a run) is enough to spot overfitting, and each eval pass costs GPU time in the window
_reasons.save_every: 100: a checkpoint every 100 steps, so a window-end stop loses at most ~100 steps of work
